name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively releasing frequent patch updates across multiple stable branches. The latest stable release is v0.63.19 (October 1, 2025), with a v0.64.0-beta pre-release also available (September 24, 2025). Multiple legacy branches (v0.58.x, v0.61.x, v0.62.x, v0.63.x) are receiving concurrent patch releases, indicating strong long-term support. Both Open Source and Enterprise editions are available as Docker images and JAR downloads; see the full release list at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases.

answers.What is the current license?: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition uses a commercial license.
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple patch releases across several branches within the last month.
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase Cloud (managed cloud) is available at https://www.metabase.com.
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported in the Enterprise edition.
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Druid, MongoDB, Presto, Spark SQL, Oracle, Vertica, and more via drivers.

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Offers far more advanced visualization and analytics capabilities than Metabase but is expensive and not open source.

alternatives.name: Looker
alternatives.review: Provides a robust semantic modeling layer and enterprise governance that Metabase lacks, but is significantly more costly and requires technical setup.
